mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_execution WHERE project_id=#{pid} AND status IN(0,1) AND subproject_id=#{sid} AND task_id=#{tid}
mapper.update: UPDATE sop_task SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status=2,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_by=#{actor},version=version+1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND subproject_id IN(SELECT id FROM sop_subproject WHERE project_id=#{pid} AND id=#{sid}) AND id=#{tid}
UPDATE sop_subproject SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_by=#{actor},version=version+1 WHERE project_id=#{pid} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sop_project_activity(project_id,subproject_id,action,actor_user_id,actor_name,target_user_id,target_name,before_value,after_value,created_at) VALUES(#{pid},#{sid},#{action},#{actor},#{actorName},#{actor},#{actorName},#{name},'逻辑删除，执行历史保留',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
